slides.title: This can read your *ENTIRE* table
slides.code:
SELECT vbeln, posnr FROM vbap
  FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_orders
  WHERE vbeln = @lt_orders-vbeln
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_items).
slides.voiceover: ये एक line आपकी पूरी table पढ़ सकती है।
slides.spoken: Ye ek line aapki poori table padh sakti hai.

slides.heading: If it is *empty*...
slides.code:
SELECT vbeln, posnr FROM vbap
  FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_orders
  WHERE vbeln = @lt_orders-vbeln
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_items).
slides.voiceover: अगर lt_orders खाली है, तो WHERE condition ignore हो जाती है। पूरी VBAP table पढ़ी जाती है।
slides.spoken: Agar lt_orders khaali hai, to WHERE condition ignore ho jaati hai. Poori VBAP table padhi jaati hai.

slides.heading: The fix: *one IF*
slides.code:
IF lt_orders IS NOT INITIAL.
  SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES ...
ENDIF.
slides.voiceover: Fix simple है। पहले IS NOT INITIAL check करो।
slides.spoken: Fix simple hai. Pehle IS NOT INITIAL check karo.

slides.title: Save this *for interviews*
slides.voiceover: Interview में भी पूछते हैं। Save करो।
slides.spoken: Interview mein bhi poochte hain. Save karo.

posts.caption:
One missing IF, and the report read the entire VBAP table.

With FOR ALL ENTRIES, an empty driver table means the WHERE condition is ignored and every row is selected. Always check IS NOT INITIAL first, and remove duplicates from the driver table.

This is a classic interview question, so save it.
